title: AID Protocol v2 — InvalidationMap
$comment: producer: scripts/lib/aid-invalidation-map.sh (E8 D3, observe-only), consumers: none wired yet — this is a request/flag for a human/PM to act on, not an auto-rerun trigger (see docs/extending-aid.md 'What E8 Does NOT Deliver')
description: Artifact emitted after a fix is applied, recording which C1 deterministic delivery-gate checks and C2 semantic-review modes are potentially affected by the fix's changed paths. Observe-only: this artifact NEVER causes delivery-gate, semantic-review, or any other stage to actually re-run.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

invalidation_map.$comment: enforced — minimal payload; full schema defined in owning phase

applied_fix_ref.$comment: identifier for the applied fix whose changed paths were analyzed — commit sha, gate-fixer iteration label, or any caller-supplied string; opaque to this schema

affected_c1_checks.$comment: deterministic subset of defaults/policies/delivery-gate.yaml check ids — ONLY checks whose required_when declares changed_paths_match (globs read directly from the policy file via yq, D3/L2 fix) — whose glob(s) matched at least one changed path. May be empty. Checks gated by non-path conditions (has_lockfile, has_workspaces, dep_removed, etc.) are out of scope for this deterministic subset.

affected_c2_modes.$comment: conservative derivation (D3): the canonical C2 mode catalog (agents/verifier.md c2_mode: local|wiring|behavior|final). ANY changed path matching a C2-relevant surface (a defaults/policies/review-profiles.yaml surface with a non-empty lenses[]) marks ALL relevant modes as affected. No precise path-to-mode derivation exists today — being honest about that absence is the explicit design choice here, not a shortcut. May be empty when no changed path touches a C2-relevant surface.

require_rerun.$comment: a flag/request only — true iff affected_c1_checks or affected_c2_modes is non-empty. NEVER an auto-triggered re-run: this artifact has no consumer wired in E8 that acts on it automatically. A human/PM decides whether to actually re-run the flagged checks/modes.
